entry_points.name: planted negative
entry_points.trace: Reverting set_config_read_hook's gate from all(test, unix) to test re-emits `error: function set_config_read_hook is never used` on the windows target (-D dead-code), proving the gate is load-bearing; restored before commit.

limitations: Windows clippy was executed locally via cargo-xwin (clang-cl plus a downloaded MSVC CRT/Windows SDK): the literal `cargo clippy --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` cannot compile the transitive aws-lc-sys C dependency on this Linux host without an MSVC C toolchain. The gate itself (same crate, target, --all-targets, -D warnings) is unchanged; only toolchain provisioning differs.
Results are implementer-run on this host; no native Windows runner or independent verifier executed the gate.

crates/oraclemcp/src/plugin.rs (windows-only needless_return) was not in the bead's enumerated dead-code/unused-import list but is required for the -D warnings gate; it is a windows-only clippy lint fix, not a dead-code item.
